symptom: `create java action … as $$ … Core.getConfiguration() … $$` with no `import com.mendix.core.Core;` passed check, exec and docker check ('0 errors'); the build (test --local / run --local, mxbuild --target=deploy) failed: 'RunSparql.java:56: error: cannot find symbol … variable Core'.
file: sdk/javaactions/source.go withCoreImport / javaCodeOnly (called from GenerateSource). Test: sdk/javaactions/core_import_2310_test.go
cause: The generator writes the imports the generated scaffolding needs (IContext, UserAction, IMendixObject) and the ones the statement states; Core, which almost every body uses, needed an explicit import line. mx check does not compile Java, so nothing before the build saw it.
insight: **mx check is no evidence for a Java action body: only mxbuild --target=deploy compiles it.** Measured on 11.12.6: with the generated `import com.mendix.core.Core;` the deploy build succeeds; deleting that one line makes the same build fail with the reported 'cannot find symbol' (the control). The import is added only when `Core.` appears as code (comments and string literals blanked) and the list imports no `*.Core;` or `com.mendix.core.*;` of its own; mxbuild keeps imports it finds, so a regeneration does not undo it. describe then states the import explicitly, which re-executes to the same file.
